entities.name: IAC anterosuperior quadrant
observations: The anterosuperior internal auditory canal fundus quadrant lies superior to the transverse/falciform crest and anterior to Bill's bar; it contains the facial nerve (CN VII).

entities.name: CN VII facial nerve
observations: The facial nerve occupies the anterosuperior quadrant of the internal auditory canal fundus.

observations: Resection of vestibular schwannoma through the middle cranial fossa approach with endoscopic assistance; relevant to transverse crest anatomy.
